title: WTT Champions Montpellier: Sun Yingsha and Lin Shidong sweep into round of 16
standfirst: Sun Yingsha dropped 14 points in her first match for about three weeks, Lin Shidong beat Lim Jonghoon in straight games, and Hina Hayata and An Jaehyun also went through on day one.
author: michael
body: Sun Yingsha and Lin Shidong both won in straight games on the opening day of WTT Champions Montpellier on Tuesday. Sun beat France's Camille Lutz 11-6, 11-5, 11-3, and Lin beat Korea's Lim Jonghoon 11-7, 11-8, 11-2.

It was Sun's first match since her round of 32 defeat at the China Smash, after which she missed the Asian Championships in Tashkent. Speaking after the win, she said injury and illness had disrupted her training over recent months and that she had returned to a normal routine only about ten days before travelling to France, according to Sina Sports. She described her mindset in the match as very good. Her next opponent is Korea's Shin Yubin, who beat Cheng I-Ching 3-0 in the first match of the tournament.

Lin needed about 21 minutes, according to Chinese reports. He trailed 0-6 in the second game before taking it 11-8 and lost only two points in the third. He meets An Jaehyun in the round of 16. An beat Egypt's Omar Assar 3-2 in a match that went the distance.

Hina Hayata beat Hong Kong's Doo Hoi Kem 11-9, 11-7, 11-9 in just over 27 minutes. Doo led the first game 8-3 and called a time-out, but Hayata won eight of the last nine points, Sina Sports reported. Hayata now plays Romania's Bernadette Szőcs, who beat Korea's Kim Nayeong 11-7, 12-10, 11-9.
Earlier, Sweden's Elias Ranefur beat team-mate Anton Källberg 7-11, 8-11, 11-7, 12-10, 11-8, saving match points in the fourth game after a long break while a wound on his arm was treated.
The evening session includes Félix Lebrun against Denmark's Anders Lind, Chen Yi against Peng Yu-han and defending champion Truls Moregard against France's Thibault Poret.
